title: Anchored OCR shortcut popup
scope: SIG4A Ctrl+Alt+O on Windows. Independent of Phase 4 Cleaner.
goal: Start the region picker directly, then show detected text, Copy and inline Vietnamese translation beside the selection, without changing the configured Local AI model.

acceptance.case: Popup placement below or above the selection and clamped to the selected monitor work area, including negative origins and DPI scaling.
acceptance.evidence: Windows all-target locked check and 28 Rust tests passed, including monitor geometry with negative origins and mixed scale inputs: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45873176979/job/140093513616

acceptance.case: Latest capture wins while OCR or translation is pending. Stale results never replace a newer capture. Dashboard OCR stays unchanged.
acceptance.evidence: Real WebView2 integration 1/1 plus Rust render-token regression tests. Tests verify replacement behind earlier OCR, popup translation, a standalone shortcut or readiness, and unchanged dashboard OCR: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45873176979/job/140093513616

acceptance.case: Native Ctrl+Alt+O opens the picker without first showing the popup. Esc on the first capture returns without showing an empty popup. A later shortcut is usable.
acceptance.evidence: Native Windows 2025 tray Ctrl+Alt+O: picker observed in 120 ms; first Esc ended picker and child PID with no visible popup/dashboard across 67 samples; the next shortcut worked: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45874026394/job/140096423956

acceptance.case: Drag a real screen region, verify the actual popup bounds, automatic OCR, Copy to Windows clipboard and Vietnamese translation without leaving the popup.
acceptance.evidence: Native 460×110 crop [40,65,500,175], popup [40,183,440,503], work area [0,0,1024,720] (96 DPI). Automatic Qwen3-VL 2B read “Close the door.” and inline translation returned “Đóng cửa.” Native mouse and clipboard confirmed both copies in same HWND and both survived warm Esc: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45874026394/job/140096423956

advisor.evidence: Independent GPT-6.2 Astra review approved exact main.rs blob 6a687b7b2a1dc7b563ee055d74016ab2d266470e and the unchanged UI, regression, placement and capture blobs; conditional Windows proof is now satisfied.

gate.rule: Record passed only after the required automated and independent native Windows evidence and Advisor approval of the exact product diff. Do not mark Phase 4 as changed.

limitations: Native proof used a hosted Windows Server 2025 desktop with a single 96-DPI monitor and pinned Qwen3-VL 2B via llama.cpp CPU. Multi-monitor/mixed DPI was checked with geometry tests only. The user's LFM configuration was not changed or tested here.
